title: Universal Boolean circuit
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on $n$ Boolean variables, form a tree circuit whose root is an OR gate and whose children are the minterms corresponding to exactly those inputs $v$ for which $f(v)=1$.
hypotheses_covered: The function has domain $(\mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathrm{Bool})$ and codomain $\mathrm{Bool}$
